name: Projected Slabs Approximation
aliases: Approximation of perspective volume projection by rendering slabs using parallel volume rendering hardware and blending the slab images perspectively on the graphics card
Projected Slabs Approximation for Perspective Volume Rendering
definition: An algorithm that approximates perspective volume rendering using parallel projected slabs to enable acceleration on hardware designed for parallel projection, with analytical error bounds.
summary: Projected Slabs Approximation accelerates perspective volume rendering on parallel projection hardware by decomposing the view into slabs, using analytical error bounds to control quality while blending results perspectively.
